title: 第13章  洞房花烛，天品武技！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
吱呀——
一声轻响，雕花木门应手而开。
门外的夜风与喧嚣，像是被一只无形的大手掐断，瞬间被关在身后。
眼前，只剩下一片浓得化不开的红。
红烛，红帐，红被。
空气里都飘着一股喜庆的甜香，暖得让人脸颊发烫。
赵辰安迈步而入，身后的木门自动合上，彻底隔绝了两个世界。
他的新娘，李青鸾，正端端正正地坐在床沿。
凤冠霞帔，红盖头垂落，遮住了她所有的神情，只留下一双交叠在膝上的素手。
那双手，指节因为用力而微微泛着白，泄露了主人此刻并不平静的内心。
赵辰安没有立刻上前，而是先走到桌边，不急不缓地拿起那杆备好的玉如意。
他一步步走向床前，靴底踩在红毯上。
没有发出半点声音，却让那道端坐的纤细身影，几不可察地绷紧了些。
一股清冽的幽香，丝丝缕缕地钻入鼻息。
玉如意探出，轻轻一挑。
那方绣着龙凤呈祥的红盖头，便无声地顺滑飘落。
烛火摇曳，一张绝美的容颜，就这么毫无征兆地撞进了赵辰安的眼里。
饶是见惯了皇城中各色美人，赵辰安的呼吸还是有那么一瞬间的停滞。
他见过的美人太多了，或妖娆，或清纯，或端庄。
但没有一个，能像眼前这张脸，让他心头猛地一跳。

不单单是五官的精致，更是一种矛盾又和谐的气质。
眉眼间自有将门之后的几分英气与凌厉，偏偏唇角和下颌的线条又柔和得不可思议。
两种截然不同的感觉，在她身上完美地交融。
李青鸾被他看得浑身不自在，长长的睫毛剧烈地颤动了几下，最终还是垂下了眼帘，不敢与他对视。
赵辰安回过神，倒了两杯酒，将其中一杯递了过去。
“喝了这杯合卺酒，你我，便是夫妻了。”
李青鸾抬起手，微凉的指尖碰到杯壁，让她瞬间清醒了几分。
两人手臂相交，各自饮尽杯中酒。
辛辣的酒液滑入喉咙，让她本就泛红的脸颊，更添了几分醉人的颜色。
放下酒杯，房间里再次陷入了死寂。
只有红烛燃烧时，偶尔发出的“噼啪”轻响。
“嫁给我，委屈吗？”
赵辰安忽然开口，声音不大，却像一颗石子，砸破了这尴尬的平静。
他问得太直接了，没有半点铺垫。
李青鸾的身体明显一僵。
她似乎完全没料到，他会问出这样的话。
她缓缓抬起头，这一次，没有再躲闪，一双凤眸直直地迎上赵辰安的视线。
“殿下，命运中的一切，其实都早已标好了筹码。”
她的声音很轻，却异常清晰，带着一种看透世事的淡然。
“得到和失去，永远都是对等的。”

“嫁给殿下，是陛下的旨意，也是青鸾的命数，没什么满不满意的。”
赵辰安愣住了。
他设想过很多种回答。
或许是委屈的沉默，或许是言不由衷的顺从，甚至可能是带着怨气的反问。
但他唯独没想过，会是这样一番话。
这个女人，比他想象中通透得多，也聪明的多。
她不是在认命，而是在告诉他，她清楚自己的位置，也明白自己的价值。
赵辰安忽然觉得有些好笑。
自己居然还担心她会心怀怨怼，以后不好相处。
现在看来，是自己多虑了。
这样的女人，根本不需要他费任何心思。
“你说得对。”
赵辰安赞同地点了点头，心中最后一丝顾虑也烟消云散。
他伸出手，轻轻吹灭了桌上的龙凤红烛。
房间瞬间陷入了黑暗。
李青鸾的心跳骤然加速，她能感觉到，那个男人正在一步步向自己靠近。
属于他的气息，将她完全笼罩。
下一刻，一双温热的唇，印在了她的唇上。
……（省略三千字付费内容~~）
许久之后，云收雨歇。

锦被之上，一抹鲜艳的殷红，如同一朵绽放在寒冬的梅花，刺目而又娇艳。
赵辰安侧躺着，看着身边已经沉沉睡去的佳人。
她长长的睫毛上还挂着晶莹的泪珠，眉宇间带着一丝疲惫，却也有一种说不出的满足与安宁。
就在这时，一道只有他能听见的声音，在脑海中冰冷地响起。
【恭喜宿主成功娶妻，万嗣天骄系统评估中……】
【姓名：李青鸾】
【综合评分：89分】
【颜值：95分】
【天赋：88分】
【体质血脉：无】
【特殊天赋：心性豁达（修炼不易滋生心魔，不易遇到瓶颈，该天赋有一定几率遗传给后代）】
【根据妻子资质评分，获得对应资质的十倍奖励！】
【恭喜宿主获得天品武技：《大荒囚天指》！】
一连串的信息涌入脑海。
赵辰安脸上的温存瞬间凝固，嘴角扯出一抹浓浓的自嘲。
这次不是功法，是武技。
而且，还是天品！
但《大荒囚天指》……
听这名字就知道是毁天灭地的玩意儿。
可这东西，对他一个连苦海都开辟不了的废物来说，跟一本菜谱有什么区别？

不，菜谱他至少还能照着做两个菜。
这玩意儿，他连第一页心法都看不懂！
老天爷还真是喜欢跟他开这种恶劣的玩笑。
不过，这股郁闷和不甘也只持续了短短几个呼吸的工夫。
赵辰安的眼神又重新活泛了起来。
自己用不了，不代表这东西没用。
这《大荒囚天指》，正好可以继续丢给父皇。
突然得到这等天品武技，他怕是做梦都要笑醒吧！
估计对自己编造的上古大能借口，应该也不会再多加怀疑了。
更重要的是……
他的视线，缓缓落在了李青鸾依旧平坦的小腹上。
系统的名字，叫万嗣天骄系统！
核心，是子嗣！
子嗣的资质，可是百倍奖励！那才是真正的大头！
这天品武技，不过毛毛雨！
就当是暂时投资给皇帝老爹了。
等自己以后能修炼了，也可以拿来修炼！
想通了这一点，赵辰安心中最后一丝阴霾也彻底消散。
他的路，不急于现在这一时，而在未来！
他翻了个身，再次将那具温香软玉的身子，紧紧揽入怀中。

李青鸾被惊醒，从喉咙里发出一声娇软的嘤咛。
“殿下……”
“叫夫君。”
赵辰安低头，用唇堵住了她剩下的话。
为了百倍奖励，今晚，必须加倍努力才行！
夜，确实还很长。
content_en:
Squeak——
There was a soft sound, and the carved wooden door opened.
The night wind and noise outside the door seemed to be cut off by a big invisible hand, and they were instantly shut behind him.
In front of him, there was only a red that was so thick that it couldn't be melted away.
Red candle, red tent, red quilt.
There is a festive sweet fragrance floating in the air, which is so warm that it makes your cheeks feel hot.
Zhao Chenan stepped in, and the wooden door behind him closed automatically, completely cutting off the two worlds.
His bride, Li Qingluan, was sitting upright on the edge of the bed.
She was wearing a phoenix crown and a red hijab hanging down, covering all her expressions, leaving only a pair of bare hands folded on her knees.
The knuckles of those hands were slightly white from exertion, revealing that the owner was not at peace at the moment.
Zhao Chenan did not step forward immediately, but walked to the table first and picked up the prepared jade Ruyi in a hurry.
He walked towards the bed step by step, the soles of his boots stepping on the red carpet.
Not a single sound was made, but the slender figure sitting upright tensed almost imperceptibly.
A crisp and refreshing fragrance penetrated into the nostrils.
Yu Ruyi reached out and picked it gently.
The red hijab embroidered with auspicious dragons and phoenixes fell silently and smoothly.
The candlelight flickered, and a beautiful face ran into Zhao Chenan's eyes without any warning.
Even though he was used to seeing all kinds of beauties in the imperial city, Zhao Chenan's breathing still stopped for a moment.
He has seen too many beauties, some are enchanting, some are pure, some are dignified.
But none of them could make his heart skip a beat like the face in front of him.
Not only the exquisite facial features, but also a contradictory and harmonious temperament.
There is a bit of heroism and fierceness between the eyebrows and eyes, but the lines of the corners of the lips and jaw are incredibly soft.
Two completely different feelings blended perfectly in her body.
Li Qingluan felt uncomfortable looking at him. His long eyelashes trembled violently several times, and finally he lowered his eyes, not daring to look at him.
Zhao Chenan came to his senses, poured two glasses of wine, and handed one over.
"After drinking this cup of combined wine, you and I will become husband and wife."
Li Qingluan raised her hand, and her cold fingertips touched the wall of the cup, which made her wake up for a moment.
The two of them crossed their arms and drank the wine from their glasses.
The spicy wine slid down her throat, adding an intoxicating color to her already red cheeks.
Putting down the wine glass, the room fell into dead silence again.
There is only the occasional soft "crackling" sound when the red candle burns.
"Are you aggrieved by marrying me?"
Zhao Chenan suddenly spoke, his voice was not loud, but it was like a stone, breaking the awkward calm.
He asked too directly, without any foreshadowing.
Li Qingluan's body visibly stiffened.
She didn't seem to expect that he would ask such a question.
She slowly raised her head, and this time, she did not dodge again, and a pair of phoenix eyes met Zhao Chenan's gaze directly.
"Your Highness, everything in destiny has actually been marked with chips."
Her voice was very soft, but extremely clear, with a kind of indifference that could see through the world.
"Gain and loss are always equal."
"Marrying His Highness is His Majesty's will and Qingluan's destiny. There is nothing to be dissatisfied with."
Zhao Chenan was stunned.
He thought of many answers.
Maybe it was aggrieved silence, maybe it was insincere submission, maybe it was even a rhetorical question with resentment.
But he never thought that he would say something like this.
This woman was much more insightful and smarter than he imagined.
She was not accepting her fate, but telling him that she knew her place and her own value.
Zhao Chenan suddenly felt a little funny.
I was actually worried that she would be resentful and would be difficult to get along with in the future.
Now it seems that I am worrying too much.
Such a woman doesn't need him to put any thought into her.
"You're right."
Zhao Chenan nodded in agreement, and the last trace of concern in his heart disappeared.The clouds dissipate.
He stretched out his hand and gently blew out the dragon and phoenix red candles on the table.
The room instantly fell into darkness.
Li Qingluan's heartbeat suddenly accelerated, and she could feel that the man was approaching her step by step.
His aura completely enveloped her.
The next moment, a pair of warm lips pressed on her lips.
...(Omit the three thousand words of paid content~~)
After a long time, the clouds closed and the rain stopped.
On the brocade quilt, there is a bright red, like a plum blossom blooming in the cold winter, dazzling and delicate.
Zhao Chenan lay on his side and looked at the beautiful woman who was sleeping soundly next to him.
There were still crystal tears hanging on her long eyelashes, and there was a trace of exhaustion between her brows, but there was also an indescribable sense of satisfaction and peace.
At this moment, a voice that only he could hear sounded coldly in his mind.
[Congratulations to the host for successfully marrying a wife, Wan Si Tianjiao system is under evaluation...]
[Name: Li Qingluan]
[Comprehensive score: 89 points]
[Appearance: 95 points]
[Talent: 88 points]
[Physique and Bloodline: None]
[Special talent: open-mindedness (it is not easy to breed inner demons and encounter bottlenecks in practice. This talent has a certain chance of being passed on to future generations)]
[According to your wife’s qualification score, you will get ten times the reward of the corresponding qualification! 】
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the heavenly martial skill: "The Heavenly Finger of Prisoner of the Wilderness"! 】
A stream of information flooded into my mind.
The tenderness on Zhao Chenan's face instantly solidified, and a hint of self-mockery emerged from the corner of his mouth.
This time it's not a technique, it's a martial arts.
Moreover, it’s still top quality!
But "The Finger of the Prisoner of the Wild"...
Just by hearing the name, you know it is a thing that will destroy the world.
But for him, a loser who can't even open up the sea of ​​suffering, what's the difference between this thing and a recipe book?
No, he can still make at least two dishes according to the recipe.
He can't even understand the inner thoughts of the first page of this thing!
God really likes to play such nasty jokes on him.
However, this depression and unwillingness only lasted for a few breaths.
Zhao Chenan's eyes became alive again.
Just because you can't use it yourself doesn't mean it's useless.
This "Great Desolation Prisoner's Finger" can just be thrown to the father.
Suddenly gaining such a heavenly martial skill, he would probably wake up laughing in his dream!
I guess I won’t have any more doubts about the excuse I made up about being an ancient power.
What's more important is...
His eyes slowly fell on Li Qingluan's still flat belly.
The name of the system is Wan Si Tianjiao System!
The core is the heir!
The qualifications of the heirs are a hundredfold reward! That's the real big deal!
This heavenly martial arts skill is nothing more than a drizzle!
Think of it as a temporary investment in the Emperor's father.
When you can practice in the future, you can also use it for practice!
After figuring this out, the last trace of haze in Zhao Chenan's heart completely dissipated.
His path is not in the present moment, but in the future!
He turned over and once again took the warm-smelling nephrite body into his arms tightly.
Li Qingluan was awakened and let out a soft cry from his throat.
"Your Highness..."
"Call me husband."
Zhao Chenan lowered his head and blocked the rest of her words with his lips.
In order to get a hundredfold reward, we must work harder tonight!
The night is indeed still very long.
